# panelcomposite {- .unlisted}

# Introduction
`panelcomposite` is a small R package for compositing images into figures. 
It has been developed for the context of fluorescent immunocytochemistry or
immunohistochemistry.
As with `ggDNAvis`, there are a few main user-facing functions and a lot of 
helper functions that users shouldn't need to interface with, but are exported
anyway in case they're ever useful.
